purpose: Select one genuinely distinct historical-only minute mechanism after Campaign050 without using any Campaign051 candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return value.
numbering_disambiguation: Historical Campaign051 is a research-campaign identifier and does not activate prospective Candidate51; Candidate49 remains the only prospective ledger.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures how the 240 close observations occupy ten fixed relative log-price locations inside their own completed-session range. No frozen factor summarizes the order-invariant distribution of close dwell time across normalized price states.
Entropy of return-frequency power or squared-return participation would restate terminal return spectral entropy and return variance entropy.
Entropy of amount or intrabar high-low range mass would restate terminal amount-participation and range-participation entropy mechanisms.
Using only the last close would restate terminal close location; using merged OHLC intervals would restate global price-range revisit.

Separate half-session histograms, state transitions, duration runs, and time weighting would add an unregistered timing search rather than the selected full-session order-invariant price-state distribution.

Campaign051 fixes ten equal-width bins in normalized log-price space, higher entropy, exact boundary rules, and no alternate bin count, scale, field, direction, threshold, filter, subset, fit, model, or combination.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_close_range_occupancy_entropy_10b
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Broad occupation of the completed-session relative close-price range is consistent with distributed two-sided price discovery rather than a fleeting excursion or terminal congestion, potentially leaving a more resilient close-known state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.formula: Across the 240 selected closes, let x_i=log(close_i), x_min=min(x), x_max=max(x), and z_i=(x_i-x_min)/(x_max-x_min). Assign b_i=min(floor(10*z_i),9), let p_j=count(b_i=j)/240 for j=0..9, and return -sum_{j:p_j>0}(p_j*log(p_j))/log(10).
selected_candidate.bin_coordinate: normalized natural-log close location over the full selected session
selected_candidate.bin_boundary_rule: left-closed right-open equal-width bins except the exact global maximum is assigned to bin 9
selected_candidate.support_rule: All 240 closes must be finite and strictly positive and the global log-close range must be finite and strictly positive; exact repeated closes remain repeated observations.
selected_candidate.normalization: natural-log Shannon entropy divided by log(10)

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against the full 74-factor comparison chain, then freeze the exact ordered no-return protocol.
